usedFor: HeySummit holds your event attendees, and HubSpot updates the matching contact through “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in HeySummit, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new attendee updates their HubSpot record, so sales sees who signed up for the event.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the contact by email, so an attendee not yet in HubSpot has nothing to update.
